items.question: Can you take over from my current bookkeeper mid-year?

answer.html: Yes. We start from your last reconciled month and catch up the rest, usually within three weeks.

items.question: Which accounting software do you use?

answer.html: We work in QuickBooks Online and Xero, and migrate you for free on annual plans.
We prepare tax-ready reports for your tax preparer. Growth includes filing through a partner CPA.

items.question: Who can see my financial data?

answer.html: Only your named accountant and their reviewer. Bank feeds are read-only.
You keep full access to your books and we send a final export. No cancellation fee on monthly plans.
